name: Gournay Norman holdings overlay v5 source-informed

metadata.purpose: Source-informed interpretive overlay for visual review on the ancestor map.
metadata.display_policy: Major interpretive holdings groups remain visible by default; southern boundary-control context is available but default-off after review.

unresolved_conde_names.name: Raincourt
unresolved_conde_names.notes: No confident modern identification found. Do not map separately.

unresolved_conde_names.name: Royay
unresolved_conde_names.notes: No confident match. Do not map separately.

unresolved_conde_names.name: Hincourt / Haincourt
unresolved_conde_names.notes: Track as a Saint-Quentin / Beaulevrier cluster note, not a separate map point yet.

properties.name: Older Gournay core
properties.historical_basis: Existing repo reconstruction of the older Gournay core around Gournay-en-Bray and the Epte frontier.
properties.interpretation_note: Approximate contextual reconstruction, not a surveyed medieval boundary.

properties.name: Beauvaisis acquisitions / Conquêts Hue de Gournay (repo reconstruction)
properties.historical_basis: Existing repo reconstruction from preserved Conquêts Hue de Gournay place-list and modern commune anchors.
properties.interpretation_note: Superseded by v5 source-informed polygon because the earlier version risked excluding Ferrieres-en-Bray, Gancourt-Saint-Etienne, and related listed anchors.

properties.name: Schematic Epte frontier line
properties.historical_basis: Existing repo schematic line for the Epte frontier.
properties.interpretation_note: Schematic line for visual frontier context.

properties.name: Beauvaisis acquisitions / Conquets Hue de Gournay - revised source-informed polygon v5
properties.historical_basis: ConDE list; Ferrieres official history; Gancourt municipal bulletin/local history; Saint-Quentin/Beaulevrier hameau and later-continuity evidence; Doudeauville Archives 76; Molagnies/Humermont local history; Hericourt locality evidence.
properties.interpretation_note: Approximate polygon representing a customary-law / jurisdictional block, not a surveyed medieval boundary. It includes the strongest listed-place anchors without absorbing every neighboring Gournay-related institutional or dependency site.
properties.boundary_complexity_note: Modern boundaries near Doudeauville, Villers-Vermont, Haussez, and Ferme d'Obus preserve irregularities tied to older Bray / Beauvaisis / diocesan geography; polygon remains schematic.

properties.name: Expanded Conquets Hue de Gournay / 24-village land context - 3 km buffer
properties.historical_basis: Interpretive buffer around the revised 24-village polygon to acknowledge that listed settlements represent wider village lands, fields, woods, rights, and dependent hameaux.
properties.interpretation_note: Useful for visualizing likely land around the villages; not a cadastral reconstruction.

properties.name: Ferrieres / Auchy / Laudencourt / Hardencourt / Le Foret cluster
properties.historical_basis: ConDE list plus Ferrieres official history; modern Ferrieres locality/street data preserve Auchy, Laudencourt, Hardencourt, Le Foret, and related local names.
properties.interpretation_note: Anchor/metadata point only; do not read as a separate surveyed polygon.

properties.name: Gancourt-Saint-Etienne / Boimont terroir subcluster
properties.historical_basis: ConDE lists Boymont terroir de Ganicourt; Gancourt local history says Gancourt was among the twenty-four conquests and depended on high justice of Gournay.
properties.interpretation_note: Anchor/metadata point only; do not read as a separate surveyed polygon.

properties.name: Saint-Quentin / Beaulevrier / Hincourt / Sully cluster
properties.historical_basis: ConDE lists S. Quentin and Beaulevrier/Hincourt; modern Saint-Quentin-des-Pres includes Mothois, Hyancourt, Beaulevrier bas, Beaulevrier haut, and Equennes; later local history places Beaulevrier under the comte de Gournay-en-Bray.
properties.interpretation_note: Anchor/metadata point only; do not read as a separate surveyed polygon.

properties.name: Doudeauville listed anchor
properties.historical_basis: ConDE lists Doudeauville; Archives 76 gives medieval forms including Dudelvilla in 1152 and places Doudeauville in the canton of Gournay-en-Bray.
properties.interpretation_note: Anchor/metadata point only; do not read as a separate surveyed polygon.

properties.name: Molagnies / Humermont anchor pair
properties.historical_basis: ConDE lists Moullonguies and Humermont; modern local history identifies Humermont as a Molagnies hameau / church / manorial context.
properties.interpretation_note: Anchor/metadata point only; do not read as a separate surveyed polygon.

properties.name: Hericourt / Beaumont / La Houssoye subcluster
properties.historical_basis: ConDE lists Hericourt and the hameaux Beaumont and La Haus-saye. Modern Hericourt-sur-Therain provides the locality anchor.
properties.interpretation_note: Anchor/metadata point only; do not read as a separate surveyed polygon.

properties.name: Songeons / Loueuse eastern-northeastern anchors
properties.historical_basis: ConDE lists Songeons and Loyenses / Loueuse; these help define the eastern and northeastern edge of the 24-village polygon.
properties.interpretation_note: Anchor/metadata point only; do not read as a separate surveyed polygon.

properties.name: Haucourt
properties.historical_basis: Pierre Bauduin places the Haucourt lineage on lands principally dependent on the honor of Gournay and describes Haucourt's fief as dependent on Gaillefontaine.
properties.interpretation_note: Anchor point explaining the northern Gournay-honor context corridor. This is contextual dependency geography, not a direct G30-G37 landholding point.

properties.name: Les Noyers / Gaillefontaine vavassory
properties.historical_basis: Bauduin notes a vavassory at Les Noyers on the present commune of Gaillefontaine held from the lord of Gournay.
properties.interpretation_note: Use as an explanatory anchor for the northern context corridor. Refine coordinate if a stronger Les Noyers-specific point is found.

properties.name: Criquiers
properties.historical_basis: Criquiers belongs to the northern La Montagne / Gaillefontaine / Haucourt context discussed by Bauduin and appears in Archives 76 topography.
properties.interpretation_note: Context anchor for the northern corridor. Do not treat as a direct G30-G37 holding.

properties.name: Massy
properties.historical_basis: Archives 76 Massy topography includes medieval Gurney-linked Massy forms, tithe/church/fief language, and later châtellenie de La Ferté-en-Bray references.
properties.interpretation_note: Anchor point explaining the Massy / Morimont Bec-endowment candidate lobe. Do not merge into the Conquets Hue de Gournay polygon.

properties.name: Morimont / Esclavelles
properties.historical_basis: Archives 76 Esclavelles topography anchors Morimont / Mont-Remond across Esclavelles and Massy.
properties.interpretation_note: Candidate/context anchor for the Massy-Morimont endowment lobe. Refine coordinate if a precise Morimont point is found.

properties.name: Avesnes-en-Bray
properties.historical_basis: Archives 76 Avesnes-en-Bray topography preserves 1503 fief language tying Avesnes to the full fief of Ferrières and the châtellenie of Gournay.
properties.interpretation_note: Anchor point explaining the Avesnes / Ferrieres western dependency context. This should remain separate from the Conquets Hue de Gournay polygon.

properties.name: Brémontier-Merval / Bellozanne
properties.historical_basis: Brémontier-Merval official history ties Bellozanne to Hugues V de Gournay and to the later administration of Bellozanne, Brémontier, Merval, and Elbeuf-en-Bray.
properties.interpretation_note: Institutional / senior-collateral Gournay geography. Keep separate from direct G30-G37 holdings and the Conquets polygon.

properties.name: Elbeuf-en-Bray
properties.historical_basis: Elbeuf-en-Bray tourism history says parish revenues were entrusted to Bellozanne in the 12th century.
properties.interpretation_note: Institutional / later-collateral geography. Keep visually distinct from direct landholding layers.

properties.name: Beaubec-la-Rosière
properties.historical_basis: Beaubec-la-Rosière is associated with a later Gournay institutional foundation, but should remain a later/collateral context anchor.
properties.interpretation_note: Do not merge into direct G30-G37 holdings or the Conquets polygon.

properties.name: Cuy-Saint-Fiacre / Quesnoy
properties.historical_basis: Cuy-Saint-Fiacre history says the hameau of Quesnoy was the chief manor of a full fief of haubert dependent on the châtellenie of Gournay.
properties.interpretation_note: Connector between the Gournay core and the 24-village edge. Do not merge into the Conquets Hue de Gournay polygon.

properties.name: Cuy-Saint-Fiacre / Quesnoy Gournay chatellenie dependency
properties.historical_basis: A full fief of haubert at Quesnoy depended on the chatellenie of Gournay; the hameau still exists and the parish church has 12th-century context.
properties.interpretation_note: Connector / dependency feature between the Gournay core and the 24-village edge. Do not merge into the Conquets polygon.

properties.name: Avesnes / Ferrieres Gournay dependency context
properties.historical_basis: Archives 76 Avesnes topography preserves 1503 fief language tying Avesnes to the full fief of Ferrieres and the chatellenie of Gournay.
properties.interpretation_note: Western dependency context layer, not part of the Conquets Hue de Gournay polygon.

properties.name: Gournay-La Ferte-Gaillefontaine frontier corridor
properties.historical_basis: Direct fortress / landholding corridor joining the ancestral seat at Gournay, the La Ferte cadet-line locality, and Gaillefontaine from the Orderic triad; Sigy and Fry represent related ecclesiastical endowment geography.
properties.interpretation_note: Interpretive corridor only, not a continuous surveyed landholding boundary.

properties.name: La Ferte-Sigy-Fry ecclesiastical spur
properties.historical_basis: La Ferte foundation and later Sigy/Fry ecclesiastical geography identify a cadet-line church and priory network adjoining the direct frontier corridor.
properties.interpretation_note: Ecclesiastical/endowment spur only; do not read as a secular jurisdictional boundary.

properties.name: Gaillefontaine castle / motte buffer
properties.historical_basis: Orderic triad plus Gaillefontaine official history tying Gaillefontaine to Gournay and La Ferte, describing the fortress, visible motte, and 1472 destruction.
properties.interpretation_note: Castle/motte anchor buffer. It is not merged into the northern context layer.
properties.survival_note: Motte remains visible and wooded; fortress itself destroyed/dismantled.

properties.name: Northern Gournay-honor context: Gaillefontaine / Haucourt / Criquiers
properties.historical_basis: Bauduin places the Haucourt lineage on lands principally dependent on the honor of Gournay; Haucourt fief depended on Gaillefontaine; Gaillefontaine official history ties fortress and motte to Gournay and La Ferte.
properties.interpretation_note: Context layer for Gournay honor dependencies and later frontier settlement, not a direct direct-line landholding polygon.

properties.name: G33 Bec / Gournay endowment cluster envelope
properties.historical_basis: Hugh III / Basilia Bec donation geography includes churches, tithes, houses, milling rights, and other property/revenue geography across Gournay, Gaillefontaine, La Ferte, Massy/Morimont, Bremontier/Merval, Elbeuf, Laudencourt, and related places.
properties.interpretation_note: Property/revenue/endowment geography. Keep visually distinct from direct landholding and 24-village layers.

properties.name: Massy / Morimont Bec-endowment candidate
properties.historical_basis: Archives 76 Massy topography includes medieval Gurney-linked Massy forms; related research indicates Hugh III benefactions to Bec included the church of Massy.
properties.interpretation_note: Use as a separate endowment-network overlay. Do not merge into the Conquets Hue de Gournay polygon.

properties.name: Later Gournay institutional geography: Bellozanne / Beaubec / Elbeuf / Bremontier-Merval
properties.historical_basis: Bellozanne and Beaubec are later Gournay institutional foundations / patronage sites; Elbeuf-en-Bray and Bremontier-Merval are linked to Bellozanne patronage and administration.
properties.interpretation_note: Optional institutional / senior-collateral layer. Do not merge into direct G30-G37 holdings or the Conquets polygon.

properties.name: Southern boundary context: Neuf-Marche / Lyons / Saint-Germer-de-Fly
properties.historical_basis: Outward searches south/southeast of Gournay show important neighboring jurisdictions and abbey geography, but no strong direct Gournay holding evidence in this pass.
properties.interpretation_note: Negative-control / boundary layer to prevent over-expanding the Gournay overlay southward.
